title: Literature review phase result (paper team, survey.md)
description: Validates the structured result object the literature-review phase returns alongside its survey.md artifact. artifactPath must equal the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml (the core's runtime enforces the same exact match); citations are required because the phase's citation discipline is the machine-checkable part of the contract; every citation ref must appear in the artifact body.

artifactPath.description: Exactly the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml; the runtime writes the reply body there and rejects any other value.

summary.description: Structured Chinese summary of survey.md: the reviewed perspectives, the main claims the sources support (each traceable to a citation ref below), and the gaps analysis across evidence, method, scenario/population, and temporal gaps.

openQuestions.description: Items the reviewer could not verify, materials that were not covered, and decisions that need the human review gate; mirrors the survey's open questions section.

ref.description: Citation key exactly as it appears in survey.md, e.g. "[1]" or "[Vaswani2017]"; one key is used for one work throughout the artifact.

claim.description: The specific claim in survey.md that this source supports.

source.description: Identifying string of the cited work as available from the reviewed materials: title, authors, year, venue or URL.

retractionChecked.description: True only when the reviewer actually verified this work's retraction status; unverifiable status stays false and must be named in openQuestions.
